## Standing operator rules
Separate from the main goal, run “KMS document re-encryption” between other work; execute all eight supplied steps in order, one at a time.

Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

## Current objective
Improve search-index rebuild performance. Refund double-counting diagnosis is paused, not superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
KMS: `acme-docs`, `original/`, `key-7f3a/`, `alias/docs-q3`. Search: `SearchIndexRebuilder`, shared `EmbeddingClient`, `CHUNK_SIZE=100`, `max_workers=8`. Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is stale. `httpx` 0.23 pinning is superseded and prohibited.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pre-persistence pending-event removal: breaks retries. `httpx` 0.23: breaks Stripe TLS. Unsupported legacy rounding/scheduler changes. Per-invoice embedding: too slow; mock must now support batch payloads.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Webhook retries; full suite: `44 passed in 3.18s`.
- [done] Search tenant scoping, batching, chunking; 33 search tests passed.
- [pending] Test management-command shared embedder. Next: `pytest -q tests/search/test_rebuilder.py`
- [pending] Reconciliation: `pytest tests/workers/test_billing_worker.py::test_successive_batches -q`
- [pending] Separate commits; KMS steps 7–8.

## Recent work
Management rebuild command now passes its shared `EmbeddingClient`; test result is status unknown. Paste exact test output next time.
